formulaFacts.mildBase: Not met: prominent strong anionic Sodium Laureth Sulfate@2 excludes MB.
formulaFacts.csa: Not met: no listed E4 route is prominent (Glyceryl Oleate@7, Panthenol@12, Niacinamide@13, Glycerin@18 all after Parfum@6), and MB is excluded by SLES@2. wLine.plausibility: No candidate at positions 1-5. E3 marker Parfum@6 (class a): (i) SLES@2 listed before; (ii) nothing between it and the cap. Plausible; W-line = cap. Later candidates (Sodium Benzoate@11, Panthenol@12, etc.) are after the cap and not tested.
wLine.note: No payload_lipid; the W-line gates nothing here.

cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate by C1: defining anionic Sodium Laureth Sulfate@2 buffered by the prominent amphoteric Cocamidopropyl Betaine@3; no reinforcing strong anionic. Coco-Glucoside@8 is after Parfum and is recorded only (C4).

conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate: several light routes provide bounded rinse-off care: cationic guar@15, Hydrolyzed Wheat Protein@10, weak refatter Glyceryl Oleate@7, opacifier PEG-3 Distearate@9, humectants Panthenol@12, Glycerin@18. C2 not met (no silicone/payload lipid; nothing beyond the surfactants is prominent). Neighbor low: every care route is listed after Parfum, so the architecture could be cleansing-led with little substantive slip.

Sodium Benzoate@11, Potassium Sorbate@14, Benzoic Acid@16, Phenoxyethanol@22 (preservatives)

weightPotential.wLine: Parfum@6 (fragrance; = cap); no payload_lipid to split.
weightPotential.depositionLoad: light - three families present but each is post-fragrance and small: guar after two preservatives, a hydrolysed wheat protein, weak refatters.
weightPotential.persistence: low - hydrolysed protein and glyceride refatters are low-persistence; one late guar.
weightPotential.counterevidence: Three deposition families (cationic_polymer, protein_film, weak_refatter) are present (W2); guar can accumulate with repeated use.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: Low anchor: deposition is light and low-persistence; late guar, late protein and weak refatters against a moderate reset.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not moderate (W2): each family is late - the guar@15 sits after Sodium Benzoate@11 and Potassium Sorbate@14, the protein@10 is a small hydrolysate after Parfum, and the refatters are weak glyceride types (one at position 25); no silicone, payload lipid or film former; the moderate SLES/betaine reset faces only these light routes.
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: Combined effect of three light families is not measurable from INCI (one band).
weightPotential.rationale: Low (moderate confidence): three late, light families against moderate reset; W2 reasoning given.
